title: DepEd-Mandaue implements 4H protocols amid rising heat index

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Department of Education (DepEd)-Mandaue is implementing the 4H guidelines issued through a memorandum by the DepEd Central Office to protect students from extreme heat amid the El Niño phenomenon. Edgar Espina, administrative officer of DepEd-Mandaue, said the guidelines cover four heat index levels: Hayo, Hinay, Hinga, and Hinto, each requiring specific adjustments to class schedules and learning activities. Under the Hayo level, which applies when temperatures are at 26 degrees Celsius and below, regular face-to-face classes continue, with hydration breaks provided for students.
